Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders

fields.helpText: The purchase-order type assigned to newly created purchase orders by default. A "journal" is a draft purchase order that doesn't have inventory transactions and can't be confirmed. A "purchase order" can have inventory transactions and can be confirmed, received, and invoiced. Use "returned order" when returning goods to a vendor; it has a return material authorization (RMA) number and order lines with negative quantities.
fields.label: Purchase type

fields.helpText: Select the standard return action that is created by default when you enter return item quantities in a purchase order line.
fields.label: Return action default

fields.helpText: Select the purchase pool that you want to appear by default on a purchase order when it is created on the Purchase order page. If you do not want to use the default purchase order pool, you can change it for a specific vendor or on a specific purchase order.
fields.label: Purchase pool

fields.helpText: Select this option to display a message when you create or modify a purchase order. The message indicates that vendor's term information, such as terms of payment, from the Vendors page will be copied to the purchase order. If you do not select this option, the information will be copied and no message will be displayed. Basic information about the vendor, such as account number, is copied to a purchase order whether this option is selected or not.
fields.label: Prompt when specifying vendor and invoice account

fields.helpText: Recommend a value for quantity field when posting documents.
fields.label: Prompt quantity field value when posting documents

fields.helpText: Select this check box to automatically recalculate FactBoxes when a purchase order line is added or changed. The recalculation process can slow system performance. If you do not select this check box, you must press F5 to refresh the FactBoxes after purchase order lines are added or changed.
fields.label: Automatically recalculate FactBoxes on purchase order update

fields.helpText: Enable this parameter to calculate a delivery date based on the lead time for Procurement documents. The date will not change if the lead time is zero.
fields.label: Calculate purchase order delivery date based on lead time and working days

fields.helpText: Select the calendar that specifies the days your agency is open, such as weekdays, and the ‘Closed for pickup’ check box is selected to indicate weekends and holidays.
fields.label: Select calendar to determine working days

fields.helpText: Select this check box if synchronization to Common Data Service is enabled and you want to avoid renumbering purchase order lines because it can create inconsistent references to lines.
fields.label: Disallow renumbering of lines

fields.helpText: Select this option to enable a different Bill-to address to be chosen on Purchase orders. The bill‐to address will default from the Invoice-type address that has been associated with the operating unit and position of the worker who is creating the purchase order.
fields.label: Enable change to Bill-to address on Purchase orders
Exclude cancelled lines from totals calculation

fields.helpText: When this parameter is enabled, the delivery address for the purchase order line will always default to the purchase order header address, disregarding any site or warehouse-specific delivery addresses.
fields.label: Always default line delivery address from the header

fields.helpText: When this parameter is enabled, the sales tax group for the purchase order line will default from the sales tax group associated with the delivery address specified for the purchase order header. When disabled, the sales tax group will default to the sales tax group associated with the purchase order header.
fields.label: Enable default line sales tax group from delivery address configuration

fields.helpText: When this parameter is Enabled user cannot modify unit price of Purchase Order Lines after line has Product Receipt for 1 or more quantity.
fields.label: Block modifications to Purchase Order Line Unit Price after line has Product Receipt for 1 or more quantity.

fields.helpText: If this option is selected, the approval status of a purchase order that is created from a purchase requisition will be Draft.
fields.label: Give purchase orders created via purchase requisitions Draft approval status

fields.helpText: Print prices and amounts on purchase order documents.
fields.label: Purchase order prices/amount

fields.helpText: Select this check box to enable change management for purchase orders.
fields.label: Activate change management

fields.helpText: Select this check box to allow users to override change management settings on a per vendor basis.
fields.label: Allow override of settings per vendor

fields.helpText: Select this check box to search for a purchase agreement when you create an intercompany purchase order from the original sales order.
fields.label: Find purchase agreements

Retain concurrent update warningChoose whether the system should allow users to receive warnings when simultaneous edits of the same purchase order header occur. Additionally, setting this to "Yes" will also prevent purchase order header from being refreshed while open, and it can impact various purchase order update scenarios with purchase order table extensions. If you do have relevant extensions, you should keep this set to No. Yes

fields.helpText: Choose whether the system should allow users to receive warnings when simultaneous edits of the same purchase order header occur. Additionally, setting this to "Yes" will also prevent purchase order header from being refreshed while open, and it can impact various purchase order update scenarios with purchase order table extensions. If you do have relevant extensions, you should keep this set to No.
fields.label: Retain concurrent update warning

fields.helpText: Choose whether the system should allow custom features to receive alerts when a purchase update event occurs in the purchase order line (PurchLine). Setting this to "Yes" will prevent custom features from receiving these alerts, even when specifically requested by a custom feature. Setting this to "No" will allow the alerts to be generated, but can impact system performance, especially if your system is integrated with Dynamics 365 Sales through dual-write. If you don't have any relevant customizations, you should keep this set to "Yes".
fields.label: Skip purchase line alerts upon purchase updates

fields.helpText: Choose whether the system should allow inactive intercompany relationships to exist. Setting this to "Yes" the system will not prevent saving intercompany relationships as inactive. If you have relevant extensions that depend on inactive relationships to exist, you should set this to "Yes".
fields.label: Allow inactive intercompany relationships

fields.helpText: Choose whether the system will automatically create intercompany orders. This parameter applies for a scenario with 4 or more intercompany orders in the chain when the originating order is an intercompany purchase order. In that case, system will automatically create remaining orders without a need to navigate to the newly created intercompany sales order to trigger the creation of remaining intercompany orders in the chain. Furthermore, this parameter is ignored in the creation of intercompany return scenarios. If you are creating exclusively intercompany return scenarios, you should set this parameter to "No".
fields.label: Auto-create direct delivery intercompany orders originating from purchase order creation

Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders

fields.helpText: Select this check box to allow under deliveries to be accepted as a final delivery.
fields.label: Accept underdelivery

fields.helpText: Select this check box to receive more items through the packing slip update than the quantity that you ordered on the purchase line.
fields.label: Accept overdelivery

fields.helpText: Specify whether to allow changes to a fully invoiced purchase order. None - You can add new order lines to an invoiced purchase order. Warning - you can add new order lines to an invoiced purchase order, but a warning message is displayed. Locked - you cannot make any changes to an invoiced purchase order.
fields.label: Safety level of invoiced orders

fields.helpText: Select this option to prevent a receipt of a quantity different from what the decimal precision rule prescribes for the unit.
fields.label: Check quantity for decimal precision

fields.helpText: Supplier requested and confirmed shipment dates enables you to do the following: - Determine the supplier's shipping calendar on the vendor and its subsequent default to the relevant document. - Determine the delivery transport days from the supplier to the receiving point. - Enhance the purchasing process through the incorporation of new Requested and Confirmed ship dates. - Consider the supplier's shipping calendar and transport days for the automatic calculation of supplier ship dates.
fields.label: Supplier requested and confirmed shipment dates

fields.helpText: Choose whether the "Create direct delivery orders" batch job should consolidate qualifying sales orders into a single purchase order when creating a direct delivery.
fields.label: Consolidate sales orders for direct deliveries

fields.helpText: During the initial conversion of the delivery schedule, any existing markup charges on the original lines are removed. When this parameter is enabled, the system automatically reapplies the appropriate markup charges to the newly generated delivery schedule lines. When disabled, which is the default behavior, the markup charges are not re-added after the original ones are deleted.
fields.label: Copy markup auto-charges after conversion to delivery schedule lines

fields.helpText: Select how duplicate product receipt numbers per vendor should be maintained.
fields.label: Check for product receipt number used

fields.helpText: Select this to automatically allocate charges when products are received.
fields.label: Generate charges on product receipt

fields.helpText: Select which quantities are posted when you process purchase order product receipts. Select Use only registered if the registered quantity is selected in the Quantity field on a product receipt, and you want to limit posting to only include registered transactions. Select Prioritize marking over registered if the limitation that you specify with the registered quantity value should be disregarded and the system will allow for transactions, other than registered transactions, to be posted.
fields.label: Registered quantity selection

fields.helpText: Enter the maximum number of purchase documents to be processed by each batch task when posting confirmations and product receipts.
fields.label: Documents per task

fields.helpText: Enter the maximum number of purchase order lines to be processed by each batch task when posting confirmations and product receipts. Set to zero to disable this limit and use the "Documents per task" setting instead. When this field is set to a value other than zero, then the "Documents per task" setting is ignored.
fields.label: Lines per task

fields.helpText: Select the method to determine how the total discount is calculated if a line discount and a multiline discount are both effective for a certain purchase order line.
fields.label: Discount

fields.helpText: Select this check box to automatically allocate charges for purchase order headers when they are created.
fields.label: Find auto charges for header

fields.helpText: Select this check box to automatically allocate charges for purchase order lines according to the charges set up for the ordered items.
fields.label: Find auto charges for line

fields.helpText: Select this option to automatically calculate the total discount when purchase orders are posted. Any total discount information that has been manually entered will be overwritten.
fields.label: Calculate total discount on posting

fields.helpText: Select this option to let users view price details for purchase order lines. To access the Price details page, in the Purchase order page, on the Purchase order lines FastTab, click Purchase order line, and then click Price details. The Price details page displays detailed information about the prices, agreements, and trade agreements that are associated with the selected product, and calculates discounts, rebates, margins, and royalties for the order line.
fields.label: Enable price details

If you change price and discount conditions, prices and discounts could get recalculated and overwritten. You could also trigger a dialog. The dialog helps you decide whether to keep the current price or discount if the price or discount is inherited from an external source. Add the types of external sources that should trigger this dialog.

Apply price discount calculation when importing purchase order linesThis parameter will allow purchase line price discount calculation when importing sales order lines. This is useful in integration scenarios when price discount is calculated externally. No

fields.helpText: This parameter will allow purchase line price discount calculation when importing sales order lines. This is useful in integration scenarios when price discount is calculated externally.
fields.label: Apply price discount calculation when importing purchase order lines

Set up default values and parameters for purchase orders

fields.helpText: The purchase type assigned by default to newly created requests for quotation (RFQs). This establishes what the result will be when the RFQ is accepted. A "purchase order" is an agreement to purchase a specific quantity or value of product from a vendor. A "purchase agreement" is an agreement to purchase a specific quantity or value of product over time. The "purchase requisition" type can only result from RFQs that were created from a purchase requisition--you can't select this type as a default value.
fields.label: Purchase type

fields.helpText: More
fields.label: More

fields.helpText: Select a solicitation type to insert on requests for quotation by default.
fields.label: Solicitation type

fields.helpText: Select if RFQs by default are open, meaning visible to other vendors bidding, or sealed, meaning only visible to the vendor bidding.
fields.label: Bid type

fields.helpText: The number of days entered in this field is added to the system date when a request for quotation is created, and results in the default expiration date for the request for quotation.
fields.label: Days offset

fields.helpText: Select this check box to use working days from the company calendar instead of all calendar days when calculating the expiration date for a request for quotation.
fields.label: Working days

fields.helpText: Enter the time of the day when the RFQ expires.
fields.label: Expiration Time

fields.helpText: Select a mode of delivery to apply by default to a request for quotation.
fields.label: Mode of delivery

fields.helpText: Select delivery terms to apply by default to a request for quotation.
fields.label: Delivery terms

fields.helpText: Select delivery payments to apply by default to a request for quotation.
fields.label: Terms of payment

fields.helpText: Select a trade agreement journal to apply by default to request for quotation trade agreements.
fields.label: Default trade agreement journal

fields.helpText: Select this check box to lock RFQs by default when they are sent. Locked RFQs can only be changed by selecting Create in the Amendment section on the Quotation tab on the RFQ case.
fields.label: Lock RFQs when they are sent

fields.helpText: When selected, the Quantity, Unit, Description, and Charges on Purchase fields will be locked on lines that are not alternates
fields.label: Lock selected fields on response lines

fields.helpText: Select a template to use by default for emails about amendment of requests for quotation.
fields.label: Email template for notification of amendments

fields.helpText: Select the method that is used to send email. - SSRS Report: an email is sent as part of generating the report using the SSRS report. This option should be used if only a few email recipients should receive the email or if the report should be delivered as an attachment to the email. - Email distributor: an email is sent using the email distributor framework. With the email distributor option, the email can be monitored in the Batch email sending status. This option should be used when emails are sent to many recipients. When using the email distributor option, the report cannot be sent as an attachment.
fields.label: Email method for notification of amendments
Email template for notification of canceled RFQ

fields.helpText: Select the method that is used to send email. - SSRS Report: an email is sent as part of generating the report using the SSRS report. This option should be used if only a few email recipients should receive the email or if the report should be delivered as an attachment to the email. - Email distributor: an email is sent using the email distributor framework. With the email distributor option, the email can be monitored in the Batch email sending status. This option should be used when emails are sent to many recipients.
